commit.message:
T-2383: the Sauganash's two ridge stacks move out to the gable ends

Andreas/Braunhold's 1884 plate draws both main-block stacks close to the ends of
the ridge — the near one immediately behind the visible gable peak. The record
carried the generic chimney_placement default (0.22/0.78 of the frontage), which
on the retained 9.92 m block put them about 1.6 m further inboard on each side.
form.chimney_placement now selects the existing `gable_ends` kit: centres 0.60 m
and 9.32 m. Confidence `reconstructed`.

No producer, archetype or kit code changed — this selects geometry the generator
already had. Exactly one asset went stale and exactly one was rebuilt, on the
pinned Blender 4.5.3 (Ubuntu 26.04), with its web derivative bound in the same
run: sauganash_hotel__frame_1831.glb. 1035 of 1035 assets match their inputs.

The 0.60 m inset, the 0.90 m square shaft and the ridge + 0.55 m top are the
kit's reconstructed choices; the engraving supports the relative disposition and
supplies no coordinate, metre, July 1835 fitting date or historical camera.
docs/LIBERTIES.md L-sauganash-ridge-end-stacks-2383 records that.

All four Hotel-dependent controlled views were re-rendered from their own
cameras and the new pairs directly reviewed beside their pictures: the hotel's
own Andreas comparison stays `differs` with the stack station recorded `fixed`
and the shafts' proportions/heads recorded `open`; the three Carpenter-shop
comparisons retain `matches` with the shop anchor byte-identical.

T-2383 remains open and partial.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
